infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses the camera so you can photograph a meal to estimate its calories and nutrients, photograph your kitchen to list the ingredients you have in stock, or scan a product barcode to look up its nutrition. A meal photo is saved with that entry in your food diary; a pantry photo is not saved; a barcode is read on your device and no image of it is stored or sent anywhere.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Siu Tim Siu Dai accesses your photo library so you can pick an existing meal photo instead of taking a new one. The photo you choose is analysed to estimate calories and nutrients, and is saved with that entry in your food diary.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Siu Tim Siu Dai uses Face ID to sign you back in to your account without typing your password. Face ID only unlocks the sign-in token already stored in this device's keychain. Your face data stays on the device, is handled entirely by iOS, and is never sent to us.
